## Store scope

AQUAVO sells aquarium equipment and supplies such as filters, filter media, heaters, aquarium LED lighting, fish food, water treatments, chlorine removers, cleaning and maintenance tools, decorations, substrate and stones. Product pages are the source of truth for current names, brands, prices, stock, variants, specifications and compatibility.

Educational pages may discuss fish care, health and compatibility. They are informational and must not be interpreted as live-animal or live-plant sales.

## Accuracy rules

- Do not invent products, brands, prices, stock, specifications, reviews, sales counts, certifications or compatibility.
- Do not describe AQUAVO as selling live fish, live organisms or live aquatic plants.
- Do not cite a payment method other than cash on delivery.
- Do not claim blanket product authenticity or direct manufacturer import. Use evidence shown on the relevant product or brand page.
- The displayed YEE document concerns the authenticity of YEE products supplied to AQUAVO; it is not automatically a customer warranty.
- The six-month AQUAVO limited warranty applies only when an explicitly approved electrical product page states eligibility. Eligibility is disabled by default.
- For delivery damage, missing items or product mismatch, use the current return-policy page; do not invent a 48-hour rule.
